workflow_runs.display_title: BUG-0067: patient slow-lane infra auto-resume + settings wiring + IPC render fix

head_commit.message:
BUG-0067: patient slow-lane infra auto-resume + settings wiring + IPC-key render fix

Fast infra-retry budget (3 x 30/60/120s) exhausted into a manual /retry on
every sustained provider outage (three incidents on 2026-09-10, campaign
6ae3ac51). The slow lane keeps re-attempting with doubling backoff
(240/480/900/900..., capped) until the settings-driven patience horizon is
consumed; attempt never consumed; patience 0 restores the legacy stop.

- policy.rkt: patience/max-delay/slow-delay/wait-chunk parameters
- infra-retry-policy.rkt: slow-lane seams, resolver, phase-keyed telemetry
- go-orchestrator.rkt: composition root + slow-lane arm (cancellation-aware)
- settings-query/settings: wire gsd.campaign-infra-* keys (BUG-0044 class)
- core-handlers: string-keyed (JSON IPC) payload renders kind + message
- tests: slow-lane seams, campaign integration, config wiring, IPC keys;
  exhaustion-path tests pin patience 0 for the legacy contract
- fixtures: go-orchestrator-baseline re-record (1497 -> 1589, target 1650)

workflow_runs.display_title: fix(release): purge restored workspace bytecode in the release test job (BUG-0065 root cause)

head_commit.message:
fix(release): purge restored workspace bytecode in the release test job (BUG-0065 root cause)

Root cause of the three identical release-lane failures (cohort-report
[ASSERTION_FAILURE] 122/5, verdicts collapsed to 'unverified'): the
release test job runs in the prepared-env RESTORE lane, which skips
setup-racket's stale-bytecode purge. Restored .zo snapshots carry mtimes
NEWER than the fresh checkout, so Racket executes the producer's
bytecode instead of the checked-out sources. Proven by the executed
suite name in the CI artifact: 'final-claim verdict cohort (c3,
v1.00.27 w5)' — lowercase — a W5-development-era source that does not
exist in the tagged tree (the tag's file reads uppercase '(C3, ... W5)').

- release.yml test job: purge all workspace .zo/compiled before the
  fast suite (preserving the frozen metadata-discovery fixture), so the
  lane tests exactly what it checked out
- test-ci-cohort-report.rkt: permanent BUG-0065 diagnostic dump — the
  fully-guarded gate state lands in per-file output on every run
- workflow-contract tests pin the purge step and the diagnostics

Local reproduction matched the mechanism exactly: editing the test
(recompile) over a stale module .zo reproduced the 5 failures;
purging fixed it (25/25).

workflow_runs.display_title: fix(release): retain per-file test diagnostics in the release test job (BUG-0065)

head_commit.message:
fix(release): retain per-file test diagnostics in the release test job (BUG-0065)

The release test job failed twice with test-ci-cohort-report.rkt
[ASSERTION_FAILURE] (122 passed, 5 failed) on a tree that passed all PR
test shards and every local configuration tried (jobs=12/4, 4-core
taskset, standalone x100, UTC/C locale, clean worktree, exact release
command). The runner captures per-file rackunit output but discards it,
leaving CI-only failures undiagnosable.

- fast-tests step now writes --json-out test-results-release.json
  (per-file category/counts/output, incl. rackunit FAILURE blocks)
- failure summary step extracts failing files' output into the job
  summary; results JSON uploaded with the test log artifact
- workflow-contract test pins the diagnostics so they cannot regress

Root-cause hunt continues under BUG-0065; the stale-bytecode diagnosis
from campaign checkpoint 40f3fc16 is superseded (CI failed from fresh
clones).

workflow_runs.display_title: fix: dispatch symbol ev-keys to string-keyed TUI reducers (BUG-0062)

head_commit.message:
fix: dispatch symbol ev-keys to string-keyed TUI reducers (BUG-0062)

Live GSD emitters publish symbol event names (emit-gsd-event!
'gsd.verification.started) while the reducer registry is keyed by
strings — apply-event-to-state silently dropped every gsd.* event at
dispatch. This made the coordinator-owned verification lane invisible
despite BUG-0058's events/reducers being correct and fully tested:
tests construct string-ev events, matching the registry, while the
only live producer uses symbols.

- normalize symbol ev-keys to strings in apply-event-to-state; the
  fix restores the whole gsd.* event family live (verification
  started/completed/escalated, wave.outcome-error, plan.archived,
  campaign.infra-retry/notified)
- approved verification now leaves a durable transcript line with
  elapsed time and log path instead of clearing the status bar
  silently (truthful final state, BUG-0058 follow-through)
- regression tests construct the exact live shape (symbol ev +
  GSD-wrapped payload); previous string-shape tests kept unchanged

Fast suite: 1173/1173 files pass (isolated HOME).

workflow_runs.name: Project automation
workflow_runs.display_title: fix: surface coordinator-owned verification progress in the TUI (#9584)

head_commit.message:
fix: surface coordinator-owned verification progress in the TUI (#9584)

BUG-0058: a healthy multi-minute /go delivery gate previously left the
TUI showing the executor's final message with no verifying state,
inviting unnecessary interruption of a passing gate.

- delivery-verifier: registry-run-verify now emits typed progress
  events (best-effort, never affects verification semantics):
  * gsd.verification.started — wave, command, timeout budget, durable
    log path, attach flag, start time
  * gsd.verification.completed — state, exit code, verdict/reason
    (reducer-compatible), real elapsed seconds, log path; contents of
    the log are never emitted (bounded by contract)
- tui/state-types: new streaming-state verification-progress field
  (hash or #f) with ui-state-verification-progress + set-verification-
  progress accessors
- tui/state-events: started renders 'W<N> verifying — budget <t>s ·
  log <path>' and stores the start time; completed clears progress and
  enriches rejection entries with elapsed + log path; legacy
  artifact-count payloads render unchanged
- tui/render/status-line: live 'Xm Ys elapsed' suffix while the gate
  is active, computed from the stored start time
- tests: coordinator emission regression (started/completed payloads
  incl. verdict, exit code, elapsed, log path) + 6 TUI reducer/render
  regressions incl. acceptance-criteria sequence (verifying visible,
  cleared on approve)

Focused: delivery-verifier 24/24, TUI verification display 20/20,
render contracts + state-types green. Fast (isolated HOME):
1173/1173 files, 17177/17177 tests.

workflow_runs.display_title: fix: bounded same-wave verification repair with exact diagnostics (#9583)

head_commit.message:
fix: bounded same-wave verification repair with exact diagnostics (#9583)

BUG-0060: a repairable declared-Verify failure now gets one bounded
same-wave repair attempt instead of an immediate terminal wave failure.

- policy: new current-gsd-wave-verification-repair-retries (default 1,
  nonnegative-integer-guarded), independent of no-change/infra budgets
- verification-repair.rkt (new): repairable-rejection classification
